One woman was killed and two others were injured in a Russian drone strike on central Kherson on the afternoon of 1 July.

Source: Yaroslav Shanko, Head of Kherson City Military Administration

Quote: "At around noon, Russian terrorists directed a Gerbera/Shahed-type UAV at the very centre of Kherson. A fire has broken out in a building and windows in neighbouring apartment blocks have been blown out. As a result of this cynical attack, a woman has been killed."

Details: Shanko added that two other women have been injured and taken to hospital.

Background: On the morning of 1 July, the Russians attacked a bus in Kherson, killing two people and injuring nine others.
